treaty_name: Convention between the Government of Ireland and the Government of Montenegro for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income (2010)
eif_quote: [ME MLI list] Ireland Original 07-10-2010 01-12-2011 || [ME PU table] 15 | Irska | dohodak | CG 9/11 | 1.1.2012 || Art. 27(2): "This Convention shall enter into force on the date of the later of these notifications and its provisions shall have effect: 1) in Montenegro: in respect of the taxes on income derived in each fiscal year beginning on or after the first day of January in the calendar year next following the year in which this Convention enters into force; 2) in Ireland: (1) in respect of income tax, the income levy and capital gains tax, for any year of assessment beginning on or after the first day of January in the calendar year next following the year in which this Convention enters into force;"
source_title: Zakon o potvrđivanju Ugovora Crna Gora-Irska (Sl. list CG - Međunarodni ugovori 9/2011), Montenegrin and English text, gov.me Ministry of Finance document

rates.quote: 1) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company which holds directly or indirectly at least 10 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;

rates.article: Article 10(2)(1) as modified by MLI Art. 8(1)
rates.quote: [Art. 10(2)(1)] 1) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company which holds directly or indirectly at least 10 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends; [MLI Art. 8(1)] ... shall apply only if the ownership conditions described in those provisions are met throughout a 365 day period that includes the day of the payment of the dividends (for the purpose of computing that period, no account shall be taken of changes of ownership that would directly result from a corporate reorganisation, such as a merger or divisive reorganisation, of the company that holds the shares or that pays the dividends).
2) 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.
2) 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties within the meaning of subparagraph 2) of paragraph 3.

ppt.quote: [MLI Art. 7(1)] Notwithstanding any provisions of a Covered Tax Agreement, a benefit under the Covered Tax Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of the Covered Tax Agreement.

notes: Royalties: 5% cap for copyright royalties on literary, artistic or scientific works incl. films and broadcasting recordings (Art. 12(2)(1)/(3)(1)) - not modelled; 10% for patents, trademarks, designs, plans, secret formulas/processes and know-how (equipment rentals are not royalties under this treaty). Dividends paid to the Government of the other State (incl. Central Bank, NTMA, National Pension Reserve Fund / Central Bank of Montenegro, National Pension Fund) exempt (Art. 10(3) and Protocol) - not modelled. Interest exempt when beneficially owned by the Government, a local authority, the Central Bank or a financial institution wholly or almost wholly owned by the Government (Art. 11(3)) - not modelled. MLI: both list the treaty; WHT effect 2027-01-01 per map.json. MLI Art. 8 365-day holding period applies to the 5% tier from 2027-01-01: Montenegro (Art. 8(4) list No.17 Ireland, Article 10(2)(1)) and Ireland (No.44 Montenegro, Article 10(2)(1)) notified the same provision; before 2027-01-01 no holding period (two entries).
unverified: Signature date: the Montenegrin ratification law and the testimonium of the published text read "Podgorica, 6 November 2010", whereas the MLI lists (map.json) give 07-10-2010; map.json date kept
